sentences.text: The Western Rivers use a modified lateral system.
Buoys there aren’t numbered, because channels shift with the river.
Shore-mounted mileage boards show the distance in statute miles from a fixed point.
Passing daymarks, red triangles and green squares, mark the side of the channel along a bank, and diamond-shaped crossing daymarks show where the channel crosses from one bank to the other.
You may never see these from Florida, but the exam can ask about them.
